segmentationGuide.role: magenta-key geometry guide; final water additionally requires master teal/shadow chroma

normalization.method: crop one bottom source row to 1672x940 exact 16:9, then direct nearest-neighbor resample; no squashing, no upscaling from old baseline

palette.quantizer: deterministic weighted median-cut with nearest-color assignment
palette.appliedTo: environment RGB; original.png retains source color appearance after nearest resampling

alpha.environment: 0 exactly on mask water pixels; 255 on land

water.segmentation: terrain magenta key AND master teal/shadow chroma (G>R+11, B>R+12, abs(G-B)<43, G<175)

motion.coordinateSpace: nearest-resampled source-master pixel coordinates, scaled directly to this grid
motion.maskSemantics: opaque grayscale; white=eligible source pixels, black=other; masks are conservative spatial/color segmentation, not independent cutouts
motion.canopy: green pixels clipped to the dense left banyan crown/trunk area (source x<175,y<150); still a mask-only source, not a detached crown sprite
motion.roots: warm pixels inside a compact lower buttress-root polygon ending above the planter wall; excludes outer masonry/ground but is still a mask-only source
motion.lotus: bright leaf/petal pixels inside two pond-side ROIs above the foreground barrier; mask only, no sprite/cutout/underpaint generated. Deform subtly in-place only or keep anchored to avoid gaps/ghosts.
